# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-07-06

## v3.9 — Jun 29-30, 2026 [top; already reported prior scan]
- **MCPs and Organizations in Team Marketplaces (Jun 30)**: admins distribute Team MCP servers across cloud agents/agents window/IDE/CLI via marketplace configs; org groups + SCIM directory groups for access control.
- **Cursor Mobile App for iOS (Jun 29)**: launch/manage cloud agents from phone with voice; "Remote Control" for desktop agents; agents run in isolated VMs w/ full dev envs; Live Activity notifications; artifact/SCM diff/PR merge from mobile.
- **Customize Cursor (Jun 22)**: centralized page for plugins, skills, MCPs, subagents, rules, commands, hooks; marketplace leaderboard; shared plugin canvases. (below bar — personalization surface.)

## Jun 17-18, 2026 (v3.7-3.8) [already reported]
- Cloud Environment Setup + Cloud Subagents `/in-cloud` (Jun 17); `/babysit` remote PR prep; Cursor Automations `/automate` skill + computer-use default + new GitHub/Slack triggers (Jun 18).

- Design Mode; SDK custom tools via local.customTools + permissions.json auto-review; Canvas context reports; Enterprise Organizations/Groups; Bugbot /review pre-push.
